description: An evaluation of the dataset block a in the app of the fixture hello-locked, from a client that does not play by the rules and gives a another state. Both locks are on, so R holds every block to the opening board, and a follows the board lock, which locks it. R refuses the evaluation with an error that names the lock and has no phase, and evaluates nothing.

conditions.message: The board lock fixes the state of block "a", whose lock follows the board lock, and the evaluation gives it another state.
